2610.05518.title: What Does Fréchet Distance Measure? A Directional Decomposition
2610.05518.paper_summary: The Fréchet distance is a de facto standard for evaluating generative models across domains, appearing as FID for images and FVD for videos. It summarizes the discrepancy between generated and reference distributions in a single scalar, with lower values typically interpreted as better generation quality. However, this scalar view can obscure what drives the comparison. For example, in COCO dataset, increasing the number of diffusion sampling steps improves ImageReward scores yet worsens (increases) FID. Motivated by this mismatch, we seek to make the Fréchet distance more interpretable by uncovering where the discrepancy lies. To this end, we introduce directional Fréchet distance, the expected squared projection of the optimal transport displacement onto a given direction. Across our image, video, and protein case studies, we find that a small number of interpretable directions account for much of the distance. We use these directions to explain the FID increase in terms of semantic concepts represented by CLIP embeddings, quantify FVD's bias toward per-frame appearance, and revisit the interpretation of Protein FID. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/yhlee-add/directional-fd.
2610.05518.paper_summary_zh: 弗雷歇距離是評估跨領域生成模型的事實標準，對於圖像來說以FID表示，對於視頻則以FVD表示。它將生成分佈和參考分佈之間的差異總結為一個標量，較低的值通常被解釋為更好的生成質量。然而，這種標量視角可能會掩蓋比較的驅動因素。例如，在COCO數據集中，增加擴散採樣步驟的數量會提高ImageReward分數，但卻惡化（增加）FID。受到這種不匹配的啟發，我們希望通過揭示差異所在，使弗雷歇距離更加可解釋。為此，我們引入了方向性弗雷歇距離，即最佳運輸位移在給定方向上的期望平方投影。在我們的圖像、視頻和蛋白質案例研究中，我們發現少數可解釋的方向佔據了大部分距離。我們利用這些方向來解釋FID的增加，涉及由CLIP嵌入表示的語義概念，量化FVD對每幀外觀的偏見，並重新審視蛋白質FID的解釋。我們在https://github.com/yhlee-add/directional-fd上開源了我們的代碼庫。
